title: Daleel
tagline: TypeScript backend for a directory-style product — API first, mobile clients later.
overview: Daleel is the TypeScript API for a directory (daleel) product. The public Codeberg repo is the backend; clients can sit on top without copying business rules.
problem: Directory apps fail when every client reimplements search, listing, and auth.
solution: A dedicated TypeScript backend that owns those rules.
architecture: TypeScript service on Codeberg (daleel_backend). HTTP API consumed by future or sibling clients.
challenges: Designing listings without a public front-end yet
lessonsLearned: An API-only repo is still a product if something real will call it
futureImprovements: Pair a thin Next.js or Flutter client when the directory content is ready
results: Public TypeScript backend for the Daleel directory line
